intro: The vocabulary of history books, with the story of the bicycle, and how the past is told.

palabras.consejo: It is written in Roman numerals and read with cardinals: «siglo XIX» is «siglo diecinueve».
The accent marks the first syllable: «E-po-ka». «En aquella época» opens a description of the past.
Feminine: «inventora». It comes from «inventar». The v sounds like b.
It is the noun of «inventar»: «el invento de la imprenta», «un invento útil».
The first r is strong: «RRWE-da». You say «rueda delantera» and «rueda trasera».
The stressed syllable is the last: «pe-DAL». There are also pedals on pianos and cars.
It is also a series of linked things: «cadena de montaje», «cadena de televisión».
The ll sounds like y: «ma-ni-YAR». It comes from «mano»: it is where you put your hands.
The accent marks «MA»: «neu-MA-ti-ko». In Mexico you also say «llanta».
The accent marks «FA»: «FA-bri-ka». The verb is «fabricar».
It is regular, but c changes to qu: «fabriqué». Cars, furniture and bicycles are manufactured.
The rr is strong. It is also a university degree: «hacer una carrera».
It comes from «mejor». It works for things and people: «mejorar el diseño», «mejorar la salud».
The e becomes ie: «se extiende». A fashion, a story or a fire spreads.
Third person of «aparecer», to appear, in the past.
Plural of «pedal», the part you press with your feet to move a bike.
«Ciclista» is used for men and women alike.
Imperfect of «empujar», to push: an action going on in the past.
Third person plural in the past of «poner», to put.
Third person plural in the past of «añadir», to add.
Feminine of «delantero»: «rueda delantera» is the front wheel.
Imperfect of «fabricar», to make in a factory.
Plural of «bicicleta»; «bici» is a short form.
Feminine participle of «fabricar», agreeing with the noun.
The rubber part of a wheel, from «neumático».
Third person plural in the past of «hacer»; the «c» sounds like «th».
Plural of «viaje», a trip from one place to another.
Third person of «construir» in the past; the «ó» takes the stress.
Plural of «carretera», a road for cars.
«Estar de moda» means to be trendy.
Past of «extenderse»; the e becomes ie in the present: «se extiende».
Imperfect of «entrar»: the light kept coming in, in the past.
Imperfect of «iluminar», to light up something, in the past.
Plural of «cadena», a chain of linked metal rings.
Plural of «serpiente»; the «ie» is one syllable.
Imperfect of «limar», to file or smooth metal.
Imperfect of «asomarse» for «ellos», to look out or peer.
The «í» breaks the diphthong: re-Í-an, two syllables.
Feminine of «extraño», agreeing with «máquina».
Past of «sacar», to take out; the «ó» takes the stress.
Past of «subir», third person: the «ó» takes the stress.
The seat of a bicycle; the «ll» sounds like «y».
Past of «empujar», to push; the «j» sounds like «h».
Third person plural of «girar» in the past; the «g» before «i» sounds like «h».
Third person plural of «correr» in the past: the «rr» is strong.
Nineteen, written as one word; the «ci» sounds like «thi».
«A mediados de» means around the middle of a period.
Third person plural of «aparecer» in the past, to appear.

texto:
**Time.** A **siglo** is a hundred years: the XIX century is read «siglo diecinueve». An **época** is a period with its own features: **en aquella época**.

**Inventions.** An **inventor** creates an **invento**. Then someone **fabrica** it in a **fábrica** and others **mejoran** it. A **moda** can **extenderse** across a whole country.

**The bicycle.** It has two **ruedas**, a **manillar**, **pedales**, a **cadena** and **neumáticos**. Soon there were **carreras**.

**The tenses of history.** The **indefinido** tells the events: **apareció**, **duró**. The **imperfecto** describes the background: **era**, **había**, **tenía**. And the **passive** is common: **fue fabricada**.

**The preterite** tells the events, one after another: **apareció**, **duró**, **se extendió**. **The imperfect** describes the background: what the place was like, what happened repeatedly: **era**, **tenía**, **había**.

**En aquella época las carreteras eran de tierra.** (background) **Un inventor construyó una máquina de madera.** (event)

**The historic present** adds vividness: «en 1885 aparece la bicicleta moderna».

**The passive with ser** is very common in history: **fue fabricada**, **fueron inventados**. The participle agrees with the subject.

ejemplos.estudio: Un inventor alemán construyó una máquina de madera.
ejemplos.alumno: A German inventor built a wooden machine.

ejemplos.alumno: At that time the roads were made of earth.

ejemplos.estudio: La moda se extendió pronto por toda Europa.
ejemplos.alumno: The fashion soon spread across all of Europe.
analisis: se extendió pronto por toda Europa

opciones.explicacion: Yes: centuries are read with cardinal numbers.

pregunta.texto: Which tense tells a specific past event?

opciones.explicacion: The imperfect describes the background, not a specific event.
Yes: the preterite tells a dated event.
That is future; the event already happened.

piezas.traduccion: In the middle of the nineteenth century pedals appeared

pregunta.texto: What is the imperfect for in a history text?

opciones.explicacion: The future has its own forms: «aparecerá».
Yes: the imperfect paints the background, what everything was like.

frase.texto: La bicicleta fue ____ en una pequeña fábrica.

piezas.traduccion: La bicicleta fue ____ en una pequeña fábrica.

opciones.explicacion: It is masculine; «la bicicleta» is feminine.
It is a conjugated verb; after «fue» a participle is needed.

opciones.explicacion: Yes: the tyre covers the wheel and holds air inside.
